clue.text: Study the sound of birds in northern Europe

parts.note: to scan is to study closely
a din is a loud noise
avian means relating to birds

explanation.surface: A birdwatcher listens to birdsong somewhere in Scandinavia.
explanation.definitionFit: Scandinavia is the region of northern Europe taking in Norway, Sweden and Denmark, so its adjective places something there.

clue.text: Firing accountants backing up the top man

indicators.note: in a down clue backing up means the letters are read from the bottom, so the word is turned round

parts.note: CA is a chartered accountant, so CAS for several
a king is the man at the top of a kingdom

explanation.surface: The accountants support the boss while staff are being fired.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing up' turns CAS into SAC, which goes before KING.
explanation.definitionFit: Sacking is dismissal from a job, the same as being fired.

clue.text: Some chaps elect to be married in church

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A few men decide on a church wedding.
explanation.definitionFit: The apse is the vaulted eastern recess of a church holding the altar, before which a couple stands for a church wedding.

clue.text: Decline scented make-up

indicators.note: make-up read as making up, or reassembling, these letters into a new order

explanation.surface: Perfumed cosmetics are falling out of fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: A descent is a downward slope or fall, as is a decline.

clue.text: Care for miniature railway in the garden centre?

definitions.text: Care for miniature railway in the garden centre?

parts.words: Care for miniature railway in the garden centre?
parts.note: the word sought means both a place that cares for small children and a place raising young plants for sale, with a toy-sized railway nodding at the little ones

explanation.definitionFit: A nursery is both a day-care centre for infants and a place where plants are grown and sold, a garden centre.

clue.text: Very large tank containing sulphur

indicators.note: containing says the tank word holds the next letter inside it

parts.note: a vat is a large tank for liquids
S is the chemical symbol for sulphur

explanation.surface: A huge tank holds sulphur.
explanation.definitionFit: Vast is a synonym for huge or immense.

clue.text: Peeping Tom having to do time?

parts.note: to act is to do something
an aeon is a long age of time

explanation.surface: A voyeur is sent to prison to serve his sentence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'do time' suggests a prison term, but it splits into 'do' and 'time'. In Greek myth Actaeon saw the goddess Artemis bathing and was turned into a stag.
explanation.definitionFit: Actaeon is the mythological hunter punished for spying on a bathing goddess, a classic voyeur.

clue.text: The music man who always makes a hit

definitions.text: The music man who always makes a hit

parts.words: The music man who always makes a hit
parts.note: a hit sounds like a chart success, but this musician literally strikes his instruments every time he plays

explanation.definitionFit: A percussionist plays drums and cymbals, which are sounded by striking them.

clue.text: Caught over party allowance, showing concern

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
on can mean over or upon, as in a lid on a jar
a side is a party in a dispute
a ration is a fixed allowance

explanation.surface: A cricketer is caught after a team gets extra time, and people care.
explanation.definitionFit: Consideration is thoughtful regard for others, a kind of concern.

clue.text: Cuts trains with no hesitation

indicators.note: with no says the following word is removed from the word before it

parts.note: to train is to exercise, as in drills or workouts
er is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: Rail services are cut without any hesitation.
explanation.definitionFit: To excise is to cut out, as a surgeon removes tissue.

clue.text: A rice dish — for the raw beginner it's too complicated

indicators.note: the beginner of a word is its opening letter, taken here from raw
complicated means these letters are tangled into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A novice cook finds a rice dish too difficult.
explanation.walkthrough: 'complicated' rearranges IT'S TOO into ISOTTO, after R.
explanation.definitionFit: Risotto is the Italian dish of rice cooked slowly in stock.

clue.text: A number took cover when so admonished

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
to hide is to take cover

explanation.surface: Someone ducked out of sight when being told off.
explanation.definitionFit: Chid is an old past tense of chide, to scold or reprove.

clue.text: Constantly after second part

indicators.note: after says the word for constantly comes behind the letter for second

parts.note: ever means always or constantly

explanation.surface: A chasing piece arrives behind the second item.
explanation.definitionFit: To sever is to cut apart, and to part is to separate.

clue.text: The head needs a lot of water

explanation.surface: A headmaster needs plenty of water.
explanation.definitionFit: A ness is a headland or promontory, and Loch Ness is a large Scottish lake.

clue.text: Fruit responsible for blunder in past

indicators.note: in places the blunder word inside the past word

parts.note: by can mean past, as in walking by
to err is to make a mistake

explanation.surface: A fruit is blamed for an earlier mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: A berry is a small juicy fruit such as a strawberry.

clue.text: Put graduates in charge — that's fundamental

parts.note: BA is a Bachelor of Arts, so BAS for several

explanation.surface: Putting graduates in charge is a basic principle.
explanation.definitionFit: Basic means forming the base or essential part, as fundamental does.

clue.text: A piece written by people put inside gets rewritten

indicators.note: put inside says the people word goes into the middle of the rearranged letters
rewritten means the letters of gets are set down again in a different order

parts.note: men are people

explanation.surface: A passage written by inmates gets edited.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rewritten' turns GETS into SEGT; 'put inside' sets MEN in it after SEG.
explanation.definitionFit: A segment is one section or portion of a whole.

clue.text: With listening device installed, refuse backing wanted

indicators.note: installed means the listening device is fitted inside the other word
backing means the word for refuse runs backwards

parts.note: to deny is to refuse
the ear is the organ we listen with

explanation.surface: Once a bug was installed, someone longed to refuse to support it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' turns DENY into YNED; 'installed' puts EAR in it.
explanation.definitionFit: To have yearned is to have longed for or desired something.

clue.text: In time accepting one is not permanent

indicators.note: accepting means the time word takes the letter for one inside it

parts.note: a term is a period of time
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Accepting one candidate in time is not a permanent arrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: Interim describes a temporary or provisional arrangement.

clue.text: The absolute maximum to the male in employment

indicators.note: in places the male letter inside the employment word

parts.note: a post is a job
M is the abbreviation for male

explanation.surface: Employing men gives the highest output.
explanation.definitionFit: Topmost means highest of all, at the very peak.

clue.text: About five possibly remain to see a goddess

indicators.note: About says the rearranged letters go round the numeral
possibly suggests the letters of remain can be rearranged

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral for five

explanation.surface: Roughly five people may stay to see a goddess.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' turns REMAIN into MINERA; 'About' wraps it round V.
explanation.definitionFit: Minerva is the Roman goddess of wisdom.

clue.text: He may well impress widely different characters

definitions.text: He may well impress widely different characters

parts.words: He may well impress widely different characters
parts.note: impress sounds like winning people over, but it means pressing type onto paper, with characters as letters rather than people

explanation.definitionFit: A printer presses letters of all fonts onto paper.

clue.text: In favour of lengthy stretch being given

parts.note: pro means for or in favour of
long means lengthy

explanation.surface: People support a long prison sentence.
explanation.definitionFit: To prolong is to stretch out or extend something.

clue.text: Artisan holding a minister is no big fish

indicators.note: holding means the artisan word keeps the minister inside it

parts.note: a tiler is a craftsman who lays tiles
DD is a Doctor of Divinity, a minister

explanation.surface: A craftsman holding a minister is insignificant.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiddler is a very small fish, a minnow.

clue.text: Steals while one sleeps

explanation.surface: Someone is a thief while another person dozes.
explanation.definitionFit: To nap is slang for to steal, and a nap is a short doze.

clue.text: An enormous weight for Bruckner

parts.note: a ton is a great weight

explanation.surface: Bruckner's work is very heavy.
explanation.definitionFit: Anton Bruckner was the Austrian composer of symphonies.

clue.text: Opening — using a key, it follows

parts.note: D is a musical key

explanation.surface: An opening comes after a key is used.
explanation.definitionFit: An adit is the horizontal entrance to a mine.

clue.text: Discontinue work under way

indicators.note: under means the work letters sit below the way letters in this down answer

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way
OP is an opus, a work

explanation.surface: Stop work underway.
explanation.definitionFit: To stop is to halt or bring to an end.

clue.text: Huts should be made secure

indicators.note: the letters of huts should be made into something else

explanation.surface: Huts should be locked.
explanation.definitionFit: To shut is to close up and fasten.

clue.text: The person observing a quarter progress unhurriedly

parts.note: S is south, one of the compass quarters
to potter is to move along slowly and idly

explanation.surface: Someone moves slowly to look for something.
explanation.definitionFit: A spotter watches out for and notes things, such as aircraft.

clue.text: A moor rings about the two pounds required

indicators.note: about means the rings go around the other pieces

parts.note: O is ring-shaped, so OO for two rings
L is the abbreviation for a pound, so LL for two

explanation.surface: A moor rings round two pounds.
explanation.definitionFit: Othello is Shakespeare's Moor of Venice.

clue.text: Former union issue — awful pest, the guard found

indicators.note: awful means the letters are mixed up badly

explanation.surface: A dreadful guard found someone's child from an earlier marriage.
explanation.definitionFit: A stepdaughter is a spouse's daughter from a previous marriage.
